newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends stable in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends stable in modest trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended stable on Friday against its U.S. counterpart amid a lack of market-moving factors, dealers said.
The local unit, which openly slightly lower responding to the U.S. dollar trend overseas, finished at T$27.572 against Thursday's T$27.570 close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$199.5 million.
"The local dollar was virtually flat most of the day, hovering between T$25.570 and T$25.575 against the greenback, which remained little changed in the international market," a dealer said.
"There was nothing strong to move the market," he said.
Dealers expected the Taiwan dollar rate to maintain a steady level in the near term.
A T$27.55-60 range was seen for Saturday.
